chunks: And it was narrated through another route, and it is: al-Ḥasan ibn Ḥudhayfah, from his father, from Muʿādh, who said:

I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: The people narrate that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم fasted twenty-nine days. He said: Then Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said to me: No, by Allah, the month of Ramaḍān has not diminished, since Allah created the heavens and the earth, from thirty days and thirty nights.

key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramaḍān, the obligatory fasting month
key_terms.مَا نَقَصَ: did not diminish or fall short

ai.seo_question: Did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم ever fast Ramaḍān for only twenty-nine days according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام rejecting the claim that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم fasted Ramaḍān as twenty-nine days. It presents Ramaḍān as a full month of thirty days and thirty nights, making the narration relevant to discussions of fasting rulings and transmitted prophetic practice.
